summary: Frontend-only testing of SharedRide Driver Expo web preview. All 9 requested flows verified and passing. Login screen renders with correct branding, all testIDs present, empty-form validation shows 'Veuillez saisir votre email et mot de passe', invalid credentials POST to https://shared-ride-pool.emergent.host/api/auth/login and return 401 with 'Identifiants invalides' correctly displayed inline, RouteGuard redirects unauthenticated user from / to /login, mobile viewport 390x844 renders with dark theme and yellow accent. Google Maps API key is correctly injected in MapView.tsx WebView HTML. No uncaught JS errors; only benign React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, TouchableWithoutFeedback, pointerEvents).

issues: Minor: React Native Web deprecation warnings in console (shadow* props, TouchableWithoutFeedback, props.pointerEvents) — cosmetic only, no visual impact

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated TouchableWithoutFeedback — recommend migrating to Pressable
Uses deprecated shadow* props on logoDot — recommend boxShadow for RN Web compatibility

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated TouchableWithoutFeedback with Pressable in login.tsx
Optional: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow for web parity

Cannot test authenticated tab navigation (Carte/Missions/Gains/Profil) without a seeded driver account — code review confirms 4 tabs with correct testIDs (tab-map, tab-missions, tab-earnings, tab-profile) are defined in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx
critical_code_review_comments: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE correctly points to https://shared-ride-pool.emergent.host; axios baseURL appends /api as expected
apiError() properly extracts FastAPI 'detail' field to display 'Identifiants invalides'
RouteGuard logic is correct: redirects unauthenticated users to /login and authenticated users away from /login
tokenStore falls back to localStorage on web (Platform.OS === 'web'), SecureStore on native — correctly implemented
All required testIDs present: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-toggle-pwd, login-submit-button, login-error, tab-map, tab-missions, tab-earnings, tab-profile
seed_data_creation: None — no driver account could be created (backend is production and read-only for testing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: If a real driver credential is later provided by the user, update /app/memory/test_credentials.md and retest: (1) successful login -> redirect to /(tabs)/index (Carte screen), (2) tab navigation between Carte/Missions/Gains/Profil, (3) Google Maps rendering in WebView, (4) mission detail screen /mission/[id], (5) shift toggle, wallet fetch, marketplace claim flows. All underlying API endpoints (/auth/me, /driver/profile, /driver/missions, /driver/wallet, /driver/shift, /driver/location, /driver/internal-marketplace) are already wired in src/api.ts.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration
